items.title: 2.1 Atomic number, proton number aur nucleon number; unsur ki pehchan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.1, printed pages 23-24.

blocks.text: 1913 mein Moseley ne dekha ke jab mukhtalif anasir (elements) par cathode rays mari jati hain to makhsoos frequency ki X-rays paida hoti hain, aur X-rays ki frequency ka jazr (square root) unsur ke atomic number Z ke barah-e-raast mutanasib (directly proportional) hota hai. Us ne nateeja nikala ke yeh number, atomic number Z, unsur ki ek bunyadi khasoosiyat hai. Ise proton number bhi kehte hain. Nucleus mein protons aur neutrons ki mili-juli tadaad nucleon number A hai, jise mass number bhi kehte hain, aur dono ka taalluq A = Z + N hai. Atomic number Z aur mass number A wale unsur X ka atom symbol ke oopar A aur neeche Z likh kar zahir hota hai, misal ke taur par Al-27 jis ka Z = 13 hai. Neutrons ki tadaad N = A - Z hai.

Al-27 ke liye: atomic (proton) number Z = 13, mass (nucleon) number A = 27, to N = 27 - 13 = 14. Kisi ion ke electrons, protons aur neutrons isi tarah nikalte hain. Jab Al-27 atom teen electrons kho kar Al3+ banata hai to us mein 13 protons, 14 neutrons aur 13 - 3 = 10 electrons hote hain. Jab chlorine atom ek electron le kar Cl- banata hai to us mein 17 protons, 18 neutrons aur 17 + 1 = 18 electrons hote hain. Is liye atomic number aur proton number ek hi tasawwur (concept) hain.

blocks.caption: Kuch ions mein protons, electrons aur neutrons (Table 2.1)

blocks.prompt: K-39 (Z = 19), Cl-35 (Z = 17) aur Ar-40 (Z = 18) mein neutrons ki tadaad nikalein, aur agar pehle do K+ aur Cl- banayein to har ek ke electrons.
blocks.explanation: Neutrons A manfi Z hain: potassium 39 - 19 = 20, chlorine 35 - 17 = 18, argon 40 - 18 = 22. K+ ne ek electron khoya, to 19 - 1 = 18 electrons; Cl- ne ek liya, to 17 + 1 = 18 electrons; argon apne 18 rakhta hai.

items: Moseley: unsur ki X-ray frequency ka square root Z ke mutanasib hai, to atomic number ek bunyadi khasoosiyat hai; atomic number = proton number.
Nucleon (mass) number A = protons + neutrons; N = A - Z. Ions apne protons aur neutrons rakhte hain: Al3+ ke 10 electrons, Cl- ke 18.
